BusinessName.BusinessNameLine1Txt: DEMOS A NETWORK FOR IDEAS AND ACTION

IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: TO GENERATE & DISSEMINATE NEW POLICY IDEAS & STIMULATE WIDER PUBLIC DEBATE OF KEY POLICY ISSUES.
IRS990.MissionDesc: DEMOS IS A NON-PARTISAN PUBLIC POLICY RESEARCH AND ADVOCACY ORGANIZATION FOUNDED IN 2000. HEADQUARTERED IN NEW YORK CITY, DEMOS WORKS WITH ADVOCATES AND POLICYMAKERS AROUND THE COUNTRY IN PURSUIT OF THREE OVER-REACHING COMMITMENTS: ACHIEVING A TRUE DEMOCRACY BY REDUCING THE ROLE OF MONEY IN POLITICS AND GUARANTEEING THE FREEDOM TO VOTE; CREATING PATHWAYS TO ENSURE A DIVERSE, EXPANDED MIDDLE CLASS IN A NEW, SUSTAINABLE ECONOMY; AND TRANSFORMING THE PUBLIC NARRATIVE TO EVALUATE THE VALUES OF COMMUNITY AND RACIAL EQUITY.
IRS990.Desc: ECONOMIC DEMOCRACY AND JUSTICE:DEMOS IS WORKING TO COMBAT THE INEQUALITY OF OUR CURRENT ECONOMIC SYSTEM. THIS INCLUDES IN-DEPTH ANALYSIS, NARRATIVE DEVELOPMENT, AND POLICY PROPOSALS TO BUILD ECONOMIC POWER FOR ALL PEOPLE, ESPECIALLY BLACK AND BROWN PEOPLE, ENSURE ECONOMIC SECURITY AND MOBILITY FOR ALL, DEMOCRATIZE THE ECONOMY, AND ENSURE PUBLIC DOLLARS ARE USED FOR THE PUBLIC GOOD IN THE AREAS OF BUDGET AND TAX JUSTICE, WORKER JUSTICE, AND FINANCIAL JUSTICE.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: DEMOCRACY REFORM:DEMOS IS COMMITTED TO CREATING AN INCLUSIVE DEMOCRACY BY PROTECTING OUR FREEDOM TO VOTE AND ENSURING THE DEMOCRATIC PROCESS REFLECTS OUR DIVERSE ELECTORATE. WE ANALYZE POLICIES, PRACTICES, AND POWER DYNAMICS THAT MAINTAIN RACIAL INEQUALITY AND EXCLUDE AMERICANS FROM FULL PARTICIPATION OUR DEMOCRACY. WE WORK TOWARD FULL POLITICAL PARTICIPATION AND AN INCLUSIVE AND EXPANSIVE ELECTORATE IN THE AREAS OF VOTING RIGHTS, MONEY IN POLITICS, AND IMMIGRANT JUSTICE.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: MOVEMENT BUILDING:DEMOS WORKS TO CONNECT THE IDEAS OF DEMOS WITH STRATEGIES TO SUPPORT GRASSROOTS ORGANIZATIONS. OUR INCLUSIVE DEMOCRACY PROJECT WORKS WITH GRASSROOTS PARTNERS AROUND THE COUNTRY TO ENSURE THAT RACIAL EQUITY IS AT THE CENTER OF ADVOCACY CAMPAIGNS FOR DEMOCRACY REFORM. IN PARTNERSHIP WITH MOVEMENT ORGANIZATIONS, WE WORK FOR A RESPONSIVE AND ACCOUNTABLE GOVERNMENT, AS WELL AS A MORE EQUITABLE ECONOMY AND DEMOCRACY.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: POWER AGENDA:A FRAMEWORK FOR BUILDING PEOPLE POWER REFLECTS OUR AFFIRMATIVE VISION FOR CREATING A JUST, INCLUSIVE, MULTIRACIAL DEMOCRACY AND ECONOMY BY BUILDING CIVIC, POLITICAL, AND ECONOMIC POWER FOR ALL. THIS REQUIRES STRUCTURAL REFORMS THAT INCLUDE GOALS AND INTERVENTIONS THAT RESTORE AND EXPAND VOTING RIGHTS, STRENGTHEN WORKER RIGHTS AND PROTECTIONS, AND SHIFT POWER TO THE PEOPLE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: DEMOS WORKS CLOSELY WITH EACH GRANT RECIPIENT TO FULFILL THEIR COMMON MISSION AND THE OBJECTIVES OF THE GRANT.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE PREPARED FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY THE AUDIT COMMITTEE AND THEN BY THE MEMBERS OF THE GOVERNING BODY BEFORE THE RETURN IS FILED WITH THE IRS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY IS REVIEWED AT LEAST ANNUALLY BY THE DIRECTORS. ALL DIRECTORS AND OFFICERS ARE REQUIRED TO COMPLETE AND SIGN A CONFLICT OF INTEREST STATEMENT ANNUALLY. A DIRECTOR OR OFFICER WITH A CONFLICT OF INTEREST IS PROHIBITED FROM PARTICIPATING IN DELIBERATIONS AND DECISIONS REGARDING THE TRANSACTION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE DIRECTORS REVIEW AND APPROVE THE PRESIDENT'S COMPENSATION. ALL OTHER EMPLOYEES' COMPENSATION IS DETERMINED BY THE PRESIDENT AND SENIOR LEADERSHIP BASED ON PERFORMANCE AND INDUSTRY COMPARISONS. THIS WAS LAST PERFORMED IN 2023.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST AND ON ITS WEBSITE.
